Pop and return the reference element at <span class="pre">`index`</span>. By default, the last reference is popped.

Raises <span class="pre">`ValueError`</span> if the <span class="pre">`index`</span> is out of bounds.

Raises <span class="pre">`IndexError`</span> if <span class="pre">`index`</span> is out-of-bounds.
